passages.text: Active recall means retrieving an idea from memory before checking notes. Self testing exposes knowledge gaps.
Spaced practice distributes learning across separate sessions. Longer intervals can improve durable retention.
Feedback compares the learner's answer with the source and identifies a specific correction.
Photosynthesis uses chlorophyll to capture light energy. Plants convert carbon dioxide and water into sugars.
Cellular respiration releases energy from glucose. Mitochondria support aerobic respiration.
A database transaction groups writes into a single atomic operation. Failed transactions roll back.
Digital signatures verify document authenticity. Editing signed pages can invalidate signatures.
An inverted index maps terms to documents. BM25 ranks documents by query term relevance.
